artifact_observations.reasoning: The text on the screen is nonsensical and illegible, typical of AI generation failing to render coherent typography. While common in low-res images, the character shapes are distorted and do not form real words.

The buttons below the screen lack clear mechanical definition. They appear to melt into the casing rather than sitting as distinct physical components. The central button shape is ambiguous and asymmetrical in a way that suggests manufacturing defect or AI hallucination rather than intentional design.
The transition between the white screen bezel and the brown casing is slightly soft and uneven, lacking the sharp, precise molding lines expected of manufactured plastic electronics.

custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the navigation button cluster. In AI-generated electronics, buttons often fuse with the body.
